scope: Credit a changed measurement's effective source or observation time to the authenticated correcting actor. This is a bounded software correction, not full story or clinical acceptance.
taskLink: Canonical native engineering task binding pending root reconciliation; do not invent a task ID or mark story ready.
originalAcceptancePreserved: Each destination field can be traced to the confirmed source fact or a documented transformation; missing data is never converted to a negative finding.
positive: Changing fallback observation date restamps present fallback measurements to the server actor.
Changing fallback source restamps present fallback measurements.
An own source without an own timestamp still depends on the visit timestamp.
Fully explicit unchanged measurement provenance retains its author.
Mixed explicit and fallback measurements are stamped independently.
refusalAndNoSideEffects: Strict facts schema still refuses client-authored author data.
Care-role, assigned-person, stale-version and invalid-value refusals remain unchanged in original fact-verification suite.
No author is invented for unchanged historical measurements without recorded authors.
Missing reasons with no measurement value are not restamped by an unrelated visit-date/source edit.
Existing confirmed visit, review/audit history and correction predecessor remain unchanged.
errorAndRecovery: Removing a measurement removes only its current author.
Equivalent copied correction-draft values and provenance retain old author.
After restoring a correction draft with changed fallback source/time, server recomputation produces the same attribution; no new provider retry or exchange is introduced.
verification: Add an additive runtime contract, reproduce predecessor failure, run unchanged original provenance/verification contracts using authentic current module selection, preserve failures and separate counts.
nfr: Pure bounded comparison over five existing measurement kinds; no route/database/provider/dependency/migration or clinical policy added.
deliveryHeld: Merge authority and observed hosting gate
forbidden: Claim parent acceptance from unit checks
